comment: Curated catalogue of community + first-party apps installable into Morpheus. This is the static MVP — future iterations move to a remote registry served by an off-Morpheus index. The schema is stable; entries can be added freely.

apps.name: Stripe Connect Marketplace
apps.tagline: Split payments across vendors via Stripe Connect Express accounts.
apps.author: first-party

apps.name: Klaviyo Sync
apps.tagline: Two-way customer + event sync with Klaviyo for email + SMS campaigns.
apps.author: community

apps.name: Post-Purchase Upsell
apps.tagline: Show a curated upsell offer on the order-confirmation page with one-click add-to-order.
apps.author: community

apps.name: Trustpilot review import
apps.tagline: Pull verified Trustpilot reviews into Morpheus product pages on a schedule.
apps.author: community

apps.name: Shopify stock sync
apps.tagline: Mirror Morpheus inventory levels to a parallel Shopify store via the Shopify Admin API.
apps.author: community

apps.name: Wholesale pricing tiers
apps.tagline: Customer-group-based price overrides with minimum-order quantities for B2B selling.
apps.author: community
